children: OpenGradient is scheduled to unlock 15.04 million OPG in November 2027. The tokens are allocated to the ecosystem, foundation, investors and team. The amount equals 6.06% of OPG's circulating supply.
Once the tokens are unlocked, recipients can sell them. If recipients put some of their allocation up for sale, the extra tokens on the market could increase selling pressure on OPG.

title: OpenGradient: Supply Unlock Releases 15.04 Million OPG - Nov 2027
